papers.title: RaReCache: Bridging the Gap in Cross-Model KV Cache Reuse via Rank disagreement-based Selective Recomputation
papers.abstract: Cross-model KV-cache reuse remains a key challenge in modern LLM serving. Coding agents and multi-model systems increasingly route a shared context across models: a user may switch models mid-session, or a cascade may escalate a difficult query. Because KV caches contain model-specific representations, each switch typically forces the receiving model to prefill the entire context from scratch. papers.title: ReFold: Training-Free Reversible Inter-Turn Context Folding for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents act on an append-only interaction history that is re-sent to the model at every step, so the context and its cost grow with steps until the sessions exceed the context window. papers.title: gr-ntnisac: An Open GNU Radio Testbed for NTN-ISAC
papers.abstract: A passive receiver can sense nearby objects from the echoes of a 5G downlink. When the transmitter is a low-Earth-orbit (LEO) satellite, one transmitter covers a wide area, but the receiver must handle tens of kHz of Doppler and a direct-path delay that changes within every observation interval. Such a receiver should be tested where the correct answer is known before it is tried on a satellite.
